records.text: Victor Marx says the Kurdistan government officially invited his organization into Iraq to help people who had been held captive by the Islamic State.
records.speaker: Victor Marx

appearances.snippet: And the purpose was we had an invitation by the Kurdistan government. We had access placement and an official invitation to go in to help those who had been held captive by ISIS.

verification.notes: ATP activity in Iraq is independently documented, but no Kurdistan Regional Government invitation naming Marx or ATP was located. Current reporting says the Kurdish government did not respond to requests to verify his operational claims.
